subject: Naolito and The Cute Side of Life: could it be a fit?
body:
{{saludo}}

Our short film Homework is on Disney+. We've worked with Netflix, Amazon, PlayStation and Nestlé, our designs are sold in more than 50 stores across Europe, and we've published books with Lunwerg/Planeta.

We're Naolito, the studio founded by Nacho Arjona and home of The Cute Side of Life. We're exploring whether an agency could represent the brand and our original illustrations, and your work with {{referencia}} made us think of you.

We have a dossier with all the details. Do you think this could be a fit for you?

Daniel Martin
Naolito
dmartin@naolito.com

subject: Naolito y The Cute Side of Life: ¿podría encajar en su cartera?
